emoji_picker.search.description: The search field of the emoji picker, its name and placeholder: it finds emoji by name, keyword, shortcode or alias.

emoji_picker.categories.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the emoji picker's row of buttons that each scroll to a section of emoji.

emoji_picker.results.description: The heading of the emoji picker's grid while a search is typed, over the emoji that match.

emoji_picker.grid.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the emoji picker's grid of emoji, under its search field and row of categories.

emoji_picker.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {Aucun émoji trouvé} one {# émoji trouvé} other {# émojis trouvés}}
emoji_picker.count.description: Announced to assistive technology when a search in the emoji picker settles: how many emoji match. count is how many.

emoji_picker.current.description: The accessible name of the emoji picker's cell of the emoji the reader already reacted with, drawn knocked out; picking it takes the reaction back. name is the emoji's short name, or :shortcode: for a custom emoji.

emoji_picker.empty.defaultMessage: Aucun émoji ne correspond à « {query} ». Essayez un autre mot.
emoji_picker.empty.description: The line in the emoji picker's grid when no emoji matches the search: the fact, then the next step. query is what the reader typed.
